note: Moves the diagnosing-sdk-health SKILL.md into products/growth/skills alongside the growth team's SDK doctor code.
Computes is_internal once in process_request_inner, reuses the bool at all call sites and threads it into billing::record_usage.
Moves batchId out of EventFiltersBatchContext into a new IngestionBatchContext that extends it; the step still returns the concrete context type rather than a generic one.
Replaces hand-built api.get/api.create URLs with the generated notifications client functions and typed NotificationsListParams.
Drops the /query/schema action and its payload builders; hogql schema lookup routes through DatabaseSchemaQuery instead.
Adds an SSH tunnel to the CDC stream reader by passing the source; the adapter still pulls connection values with untyped inputs.get calls.
Moves product enablement out of the signals product into core posthog/api with core generated clients; not colocated with onboarding code.
Coerces numeric leaf identity fields and replaces a local leaf iterator with a shared walker; the old loop-check function is untouched.
Extracts getLocalTimeZone into lib/utils/timezones and uses it in LogsWidget.
Regenerates OPS HCL from dumps, tweaking queries and dropping column_aliases; SQL stays inline as long strings, no file loading.
Derives the bulk_delete filter allow-list from BulkDeleteFiltersSerializer field keys and tightens fields to ChoiceFields.
Evaluates the enforcement rollout flag against the target team's organization; no shared scope-derivation helper is extracted.
Removes the loadIntegrationsSuccess listener and loads GitHub installations from a mount effect in the GithubIntegration component.
Empties the feature_flags facade __init__.py by removing the re-export block.
Removes duplicated automation fields, adds properties deriving them from the task and last task run, and a default manager that select_related them.
Replaces the manual batch timer and beforeUnmount clearTimeout with a keyed cache.disposables entry.
Removes the target_sharded_events context flag and its events-table special case, reusing an existing mechanism for deletion predicates.
Deletes the signals-owned RepoSelection mirror schema and uses the tasks RepoSelectionResult type directly for repo_selection artefacts.
Renames tracing MCP tools to an apm namespace, with the span query tool named query-apm-spans.
Drops the schema_metadata propagation on update; pipeline now prefers config.schema from job inputs over stored source_schema.
